manifest.name: dsh-plugin-subagent-director
manifest.description: Subagent Director: choose an LLM provider/model for each subagent (call args > role binding > plugin default > inherit parent) and plan main-agent/subagent responsibilities with role templates, plus a settings UI.

bundle.text:
# dsh-plugin-subagent-director bundle patch.
#
# Adds the plugin's two entries: the main entry and the settings bridge that
# exposes the `subagent-director` settings namespace to the Web UI.
# Install: dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-plugin-subagent-director
# Restart `dsh --profile <name>` after installing.
- insert:
    - id: subagent-director
      name: dsh-plugin-subagent-director
- insert:
    - id: subagent-director-bridge
      name: dsh-plugin-subagent-director/bridge

readme.text: <div align="center">

**为 DeepSeek Harness 的 subagent 指定 LLM 供应商与模型，并用「角色模板」规划主代理与子代理的分工** [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-subagent-director) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-subagent-director) [](LICENSE) [](package.json) [](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-plugin-subagent-director/releases) [](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-plugin-subagent-director) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

**Subagent Director** 是一个 out-of-tree 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于为 subagent 指定 LLM 供应商与模型，并通过「角色模板」规划主代理与子代理的分工。

---

- **供应商与模型选择** —— 为 subagent 配置默认 LLM 供应商（route）与模型；每次委派也可以由模型显式指定 `provider` / `model`；
- **受控的模型选择** —— provider/model 只从官方 `subagent-model-selection` 授权列表
  （`allowedModels`）中选择：显式传入未授权路由为硬错误，角色/默认层未授权路由被
  丢弃并回退继承（不与官方 dsh-tool-subagent 双重写模型路由）；
- **配置热更新** —— settings.yaml / 插件配置页的改动即时生效，无需重启；
- **角色按显示名引用** —— `role` 参数未命中 id 时按 `displayName` 精确匹配（重名
  取定义顺序第一个并提示），模型按显示名也能命中模板；
- **角色模板** —— 定义「代码审查员」「翻译员」等角色：职责描述（给主代理看）+ 可选 Agent Preset（persona/工具组合）+ 可选模型绑定；
- **四级回退链** —— 单次调用参数 > 角色绑定 > 插件默认 > 继承主代理（未配置时零侵入）；
- **主代理指引** —— 系统提示自动注入角色清单，主代理知道何时委派给谁；
- **配置界面** —— 插件详情页内可视化配置（插件列表 → dsh-plugin-subagent-director；默认模型 + 角色模板增删改），视觉与 DSH 官方设置页设计语言一致，亮暗主题通用；设置面板不再承载本插件配置；
- **continuable 后台** —— 返回可续聊子代理 id，配合 send_message 持续委派；
- **释放可持续子代理** —— 模型可见工具 `close_subagent(subagent_id)` 与子代理会话
  页的「终止可持续状态」按钮，主动释放已完成但仍驻留的 continuable 子代理
  （内部调用 DSH 核心 `drainChildren`）；
- **可观测性** —— 打开子代理会话时，composer 下方显示其实际运行的供应商/模型
  （从会话 `request/header` 记录读取真实路由；读不到时优雅降级）；

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-plugin-subagent-director
```

或本地开发时以 `dsh plugin --profile <name> add link:<绝对路径>` 挂载本地 checkout
（配置示例见下）。

- 推荐直接 `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-plugin-subagent-director`（npm
  发布版已包含构建产物，peer 依赖由 DSH 的 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules`
  fallback 提供，开箱即用）。
- 本地 `link:` 开发时：git 仓库不包含 `lib/`（已被 .gitignore），挂载前需先
  `npm install && npm run build`；且 checkout 需位于 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/` 下
  （或仓库自带 node_modules），否则 `@deepseek-ai/*` peer 依赖会报
  `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`。

对话中委派（主代理会看到角色清单指引，自动选择工具与角色）：

```text
subagent_role({ role: "translator", prompt: "把 README.md 翻译成英文" })
subagent_role({ role: "code-reviewer", model: "deepseek-chat", prompt: "..." })  # 临时覆盖模型
```

`role` 参数支持用角色 id 或显示名引用：未命中 id 时会按 `displayName` 精确匹配
（多个同名角色取定义顺序第一个并提示）；建议始终用 id，见系统提示中的 Delegate 行。

> **`subagent_role` 与内置 `subagent` 是两个不同的工具。** 本插件注册的是
> `subagent_role`（工具名由 `toolName` 配置，默认 `subagent_role`）；DSH 基础
> bundle 另有内置的 `subagent` / `subagent_fork`，两者在同一次请求的工具清单里
> **并存**。只有走 `subagent_role` 才会应用角色绑定的 `agentPreset`（persona/工具由 preset 承载）；模型改用
> 内置 `subagent` 时这两项不生效（模型选择由官方 dsh-tool-subagent 的
> `modelSelectionSettings` 负责）。
> 因此需要角色语义时，请在提示里明确要求调用 `subagent_role`。
以下截图来自本地一次性预览实例，示例数据仅用于演示：

`dsh plugin add` 会通过插件包自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 自动挂载主条目与桥接条目
（`subagent-director` / `subagent-director-bridge`，桥接条目用于把设置命名空间
暴露给 Web UI），**不需要**手动 `insert`。需要覆盖默认配置时按 id 覆盖主条目：

```yaml
- id: subagent-director
  name: dsh-plugin-subagent-director
  config:
    subagentProvider: spawn      # 传输：spawn（无父上下文）/ fork（继承父历史）

> 注意：不要再用 `- insert:` 添加这两个条目，否则启动会报
> `duplicate loader entry id`。

settings 命名空间 `subagent-director`。角色可以不绑定 provider/model（继承全局
默认模型），也可以按需绑定。推荐默认角色（含委派指引与可选 Agent Preset；
DSH 0.2.1 的 persona/toolFilter 由 Agent Preset 承载，下面示例假定已创建同名 preset）：

```yaml
subagent-director:
  defaultProvider: anthropic
  defaultModel: mythos-10
  defaultReasoningEffort: max

```text
/orchestrate 分析上周A股走势   # 本轮开启并直接编排该任务（推荐用法）
/orchestrate                  # 本轮开启（按轮生效，无需 on/off）
/orchestrate on               # 持久开启（直到 /orchestrate off）
/orchestrate off              # 退出持久模式

在消息开头声明 `/orchestrate`（可后接任务文本，如 `/orchestrate 分析上周A股走势`），
或用自然语言写「使用orchestrate模式」（含「请使用 orchestrate 模式」「use
orchestrate mode」等变体），该轮会话即自动进入纯编排模式——类似 `/using aegis`
的按轮声明式用法，无需记忆开关状态；未声明时保持普通模式。`/orchestrate <任务>`
会把任务文本排入下一轮并唤醒模型，该轮以纯编排模式处理任务。开启后注入一段
「纯编排者」系统提示：主代理只允许通过委派工具派活，角色清单从当前
`subagent-director.roles` 动态渲染（无硬编码 role id）。**未配置角色时**不会注入
束缚性的纯编排框架，而是注入一段简短提示，让模型明确告知需要先配置角色并继续
以普通模式处理请求（避免「对话无输出」）。该模式依赖宿主的 `commands` 与
`sessionProjections` 服务：标准 profile（dsh-base）都会提供二者；
`sessionProjections` 缺失时命令返回明确错误而不是假装成功，`commands` 缺失时
命令不注册，插件其余功能不受影响。

readme.section: 🧭 与官方子代理选择器的适配 / Official Subagent Selector Adaptation
readme.text: DSH alpha.4 起，官方内置 subagent 的模型选择收敛到 `subagent-model-selection` 设置段（`allowedModels` 授权列表）。本插件 v0.5.0 完全适配该机制：

readme.section: 🧭 与官方子代理选择器的适配 / Official Subagent Selector Adaptation
readme.text:
- **只从授权列表选择** —— `route-resolver` 把 provider/model 约束在官方
  `subagent-model-selection.allowedModels` 内：显式传入未授权路由为**硬错误**；
  插件默认层 / 角色绑定层的未授权路由被**丢弃并回退继承主代理**；
- **不再双重写模型路由** —— 移除 rc 时代的 `applyDefaultRoute` 补丁缝，插件与
  官方选择器不会各自覆盖同一条路由（设置面板可选的 provider/model 即官方
  「插件-插件配置-Subagent池」里的选项）；
- **客户端半同步移植** —— 移除 rc 时代对 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime/client`
  （`dsh-client-runtime` 包）的全部引用（alpha.4/alpha.5 宿主均不携带该包），dock 读数改读 alpha.4 会话
  `request/header` 记录，配置页在 alpha.4/alpha.5 宿主均可正常加载。

- **subagentProvider（传输）**：`spawn` / `fork` / `acp`——子代理跑在哪条传输链路上；
- **provider（LLM route）**：`deepseek-official`、pi-ai route——模型请求实际发给哪个供应商。

两者是**两套命名空间**，配置时不要混淆。

DSH 0.2.1 起兼容门禁优先读取 `engines.dsh`。本插件声明 **`engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.1"`**，全部 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer 也收敛到 `>=0.2.1-rc.1`：

| DSH 版本 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 0.2.1-rc.1 | ✅ typecheck / 297 测试 / 构建 / 门禁 |
| 0.2.1-rc.2 | ✅ 兼容门禁通过 |

> 只列出**实际跑过**的版本；未实测的不列。

v0.6.0-beta.2 支持 DSH **0.2.1-rc.1+**。0.6.0-beta.1 把子代理接缝统一到 `startActivation` / `drainChildren`，并按官方方向把 persona 与工具组合迁移到 **Agent Preset**（角色模板新增 `agentPreset` 字段）；0.6.0-beta.2 在此基础上按 DSH 官方设计语言重做了设置界面（主题令牌、字号阶梯、统一卡片 / 按钮 / 开关 / 焦点环，亮暗主题一致），功能与协议不变。**破坏性**：0.1.x / 0.2.0-rc.1 仍不兼容，旧宿主请继续使用 **0.5.6**。

```bash
npm install
npm test          # vitest（297 用例）
npm run typecheck
npm run build     # host(tsc) + client(rolldown bundle)

**为什么需要两个插件条目？**
DSH 的 Web API 只向白名单内的 settings 命名空间开放读写。本插件通过自注册的 `/subagent-director` HTTP 路由桥接自己的命名空间，而该路由依赖的 webServer 服务只能经 cordis `inject` 获取，因此拆成独立的 `subagent-director-bridge` 条目（无 Web 的 headless 场景它会自动不激活，主条目不受影响）。

**放在反向代理/网关后面，设置页提示「此服务器尚未提供设置桥接通道」怎么办？**
桥接路由默认只接受回环 Host（`localhost`、`127.0.0.0/8`、`[::1]`），避免设置写在无人看守的公网上裸奔。经反向代理用域名访问时 Host 不是回环地址，请求被 403 拒绝，而前端把任何失败都渲染成上面那句提示，看不出真实原因。把该域名加进白名单即可（端口与大小写不敏感）。

优先在 `config.yaml` 里配置桥接条目：

```yaml
- id: subagent-director-bridge
  name: dsh-plugin-subagent-director/bridge
  config:
    trustedHosts:

旧的逗号分隔环境变量仍保留作 fallback，与 Config 取并集：

```bash
DSH_SUBAGENT_DIRECTOR_TRUSTED_HOSTS=dsh.example.com
```

不配置时行为与之前完全一致（依旧只认回环）；白名单只解除这一层围栏，域名仍需通过你自己的认证层。

**未配置任何角色时行为如何？**
未配置任何角色且未配置默认模型时与未安装本插件完全一致（零侵入）。配置了
`defaultProvider`/`defaultModel` 时：若官方 `subagent-model-selection` 已启用并有
`allowedModels` 授权列表，默认路由仅在该列表内才生效（否则被丢弃并回退继承）；若
未配置授权列表，则保留插件默认行为并给出警告提示。

**用过 `/orchestrate` 的会话，卸载插件后还能打开吗？**
不能。`/orchestrate` 会在会话日志写入 `orchestrate/change` 事件，而宿主的持久化
加载校验遇到「未知且未标记 ignorable」的事件类型时会拒绝加载整个日志（避免误解
日志语义）。插件挂载时会动态注册该事件类型，正常使用不受影响；但在未挂载本插件
的环境（卸载后、其他 profile）中，这些会话将无法打开。上游暂未提供第三方事件
类型的官方注册或 `ignorable` 写入 API，此为已知取舍，详见
[issue #6](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-plugin-subagent-director/issues/6)。

**新供应商/API 会自动出现吗？**
会。配置页订阅了供应商与设置变更事件，在 Models 页新增供应商/API key 后，下拉列表自动刷新，无需重启。

<div align="center">
**Assign an LLM provider and model to DeepSeek Harness subagents, and plan the main-agent / subagent division of labor with role templates**

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-subagent-director) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-subagent-director) [](LICENSE) [](package.json) [](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-plugin-subagent-director/releases) [](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-plugin-subagent-director) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

**Subagent Director** is an out-of-tree DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets you choose an LLM provider and model for subagents, and plan main-agent / subagent responsibilities through role templates.

---

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-plugin-subagent-director
```

Or, for local development, mount a local checkout with `dsh plugin --profile <name> add link:<absolute path>`
(see the configuration example below).

- Prefer `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-plugin-subagent-director` directly (the npm
  release already includes the build output; peer dependencies are provided by DSH's
  `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules` fallback, so it works out of the box).
- For local `link:` development: the git repo does not contain `lib/` (it is .gitignore'd),
  so run `npm install && npm run build` before mounting; and the checkout must live under
  `$DSH_HOME/profiles/` (or the repo must carry its own node_modules), otherwise the
  `@deepseek-ai/*` peer dependencies fail with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`.

Delegating in a conversation (the main agent sees the role-list guidance and picks the tool and role automatically):

```text
subagent_role({ role: "translator", prompt: "把 README.md 翻译成英文" })
subagent_role({ role: "code-reviewer", model: "deepseek-chat", prompt: "..." })  # 临时覆盖模型
```

The `role` argument accepts a role id or a display name: when it misses an id it is matched
exactly by `displayName` (the first of same-named roles in definition order is used, with a
notice); using ids is recommended, see the Delegate line in the system prompt.

> **`subagent_role` and the built-in `subagent` are two different tools.** This plugin
> registers `subagent_role` (the tool name comes from the `toolName` config, `subagent_role`
> by default); the DSH base bundle also ships the built-in `subagent` / `subagent_fork`, and
> both appear **side by side** in the tool list of the same request. Only calls through
> `subagent_role` applies the role-bound `agentPreset` (persona/tools live inside the preset); switching the model to the built-in
> `subagent` disables both (model selection is handled by the official dsh-tool-subagent's
> `modelSelectionSettings`).
> So when role semantics are needed, explicitly ask in the prompt to call `subagent_role`.
The screenshot below comes from a throwaway local preview instance; the example data is for demonstration only:

`dsh plugin add` auto-mounts the main and bridge entries (via the `cordis.patch.yml` shipped
with the package — `subagent-director` / `subagent-director-bridge`; the bridge entry exposes
the settings namespace to the Web UI), so you do **not** `insert` them manually. To override
the default configuration, override the main entry by id:

```yaml
- id: subagent-director
  name: dsh-plugin-subagent-director
  config:
    subagentProvider: spawn      # 传输：spawn（无父上下文）/ fork（继承父历史）

> Note: do not add these two entries with `- insert:` again, or startup fails with
> `duplicate loader entry id`.

Settings namespace `subagent-director`. Roles may leave provider/model unbound (inheriting the
global default model) or bind them as needed. Recommended default roles (with delegation
guidance and an optional Agent Preset; DSH 0.2.1 owns persona/tool composition in the preset, and the examples assume presets with these ids exist):

```yaml
subagent-director:
  defaultProvider: opencode-go
  defaultModel: minimax-m2.7
  defaultReasoningEffort: low

```text
/orchestrate 分析上周A股走势   # 本轮开启并直接编排该任务（推荐用法）
/orchestrate                  # 本轮开启（按轮生效，无需 on/off）
/orchestrate on               # 持久开启（直到 /orchestrate off）
/orchestrate off              # 退出持久模式

Declare `/orchestrate` at the start of a message (optionally followed by the task text, e.g.
`/orchestrate 分析上周A股走势`), or write "use orchestrate mode" in natural language (including
variants such as "请使用 orchestrate 模式" and "use orchestrate mode"), and that turn
automatically enters pure-orchestration mode — a per-turn declarative usage similar to
`/using aegis`, with no need to remember a toggle state; without the declaration, normal mode
is kept. `/orchestrate <task>` queues the task text into the next turn and wakes the model,
which handles the task in pure-orchestration mode. Once enabled, a "pure orchestrator" system
prompt is injected: the main agent may only hand out work through delegation tools, and the
role list is rendered dynamically from the current `subagent-director.roles` (no hard-coded
role ids). **When no roles are configured**, the binding pure-orchestration framework is not
injected; instead a short prompt tells the model to state that roles must be configured first
and to continue handling the request in normal mode (avoiding "no output in the conversation").

readme.section: 🧭 与官方子代理选择器的适配 / Official Subagent Selector Adaptation
readme.text: Since DSH alpha.4, the built-in subagent's model selection converges on the official `subagent-model-selection` settings section (the `allowedModels` allowlist). This plugin v0.5.0 fully adapts to that mechanism:

readme.section: 🧭 与官方子代理选择器的适配 / Official Subagent Selector Adaptation
readme.text:
- **Select only from the allowlist** — `route-resolver` constrains provider/model to the
  official `subagent-model-selection.allowedModels`: an explicitly passed unauthorized route is
  a **hard error**; unauthorized routes at the plugin-default / role-binding layer are
  **dropped and fall back to inherit from the main agent**;
- **No more double-writing of model routes** — the rc-era `applyDefaultRoute` patch seam is
  removed, so the plugin and the official selector never overwrite the same route
  (the provider/model selectable in the settings panel are exactly the options in the official
  "Plugins → plugin config → Subagent pool");
- **Client half migrated in step** — all rc-era references to
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime/client` (the `dsh-client-runtime` package) are removed
  (neither the alpha.4 nor alpha.5 host carries that package); the dock reading now reads the
  alpha.4 session `request/header` records, and the config page loads normally on both alpha.4
  and alpha.5 hosts.

Since DSH 0.2.1 the compatibility gate prefers `engines.dsh`. This plugin declares **`engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.1"`**, and every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer is likewise `>=0.2.1-rc.1`:

| DSH version | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 0.2.1-rc.1 | ✅ typecheck / 297 tests / build / gate |
| 0.2.1-rc.2 | ✅ gate |

> Only versions that were **actually run** are listed; untested versions are omitted.

v0.6.0-beta.2 targets DSH **0.2.1-rc.1+**. 0.6.0-beta.1 unified the subagent seam on `startActivation` / `drainChildren` and migrated persona/tool composition to an independent Agent Preset, adding an `agentPreset` field to role templates; 0.6.0-beta.2 rebuilds the settings UI on the official DSH design language (theme tokens, type scale, unified cards / buttons / switches / focus rings, light and dark themes), with no functional or protocol change. **Breaking**: 0.1.x / 0.2.0-rc.1 remain unsupported; use **0.5.6** on older hosts.

```bash
npm install
npm test          # vitest (297 tests)
npm run typecheck
npm run build     # host(tsc) + client(rolldown bundle)

**Why are two plugin entries needed?**
DSH's Web API only opens read/write to a whitelisted set of settings namespaces. This plugin bridges its own namespace through a self-registered `/subagent-director` HTTP route, and the webServer service that route depends on can only be obtained via cordis `inject`, so it is split into a separate `subagent-director-bridge` entry (in a headless environment without Web it simply does not activate, and the main entry is unaffected).

**What happens when no roles are configured?**
With no roles and no default model configured it behaves exactly as if the plugin were not installed (zero intrusion). With `defaultProvider`/`defaultModel` configured: if the official `subagent-model-selection` is enabled and has an `allowedModels` allowlist, the default route takes effect only within that list (otherwise it is dropped and falls back to inheritance); if no allowlist is configured, the plugin's default behavior is kept and a warning is shown.

**Can a session that used `/orchestrate` still be opened after uninstalling the plugin?**
No. `/orchestrate` writes an `orchestrate/change` event into the session log, and the host's persistence-load validation rejects loading the entire log when it meets an event type that is "unknown and not marked ignorable" (to avoid misreading the log's semantics). The plugin registers that event type dynamically when mounted, so normal use is unaffected; but in an environment where this plugin is not mounted (after uninstall, or another profile) these sessions cannot be opened. Upstream does not yet provide an official registration API or an `ignorable` write API for third-party event types — a known trade-off, see [issue #6](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-plugin-subagent-director/issues/6).

**Do new providers/APIs appear automatically?**
Yes. The config page subscribes to provider and settings change events; after you add a provider/API key on the Models page, the dropdown refreshes automatically, with no restart.
